bio: What a location! This trendy, urban-style restaurant is housed on the eighth floor of an office building right in the centre of Magdeburg – the view across the city and the Gothic cathedral, which dates back over 500 years, is a major highlight. In summer, the terrace tables are much in demand. The fresh, contemporary dishes are also available as a sharing menu. Among the tempting options are braised aubergine with feta and Taggiasca olives, as well as pan-fried redfish fillet with papaya and fregola sarda. Tip: Do reserve in advance, as the restaurant is consistently busy.
